jobs.occupation: University Professor of Functional Genomics and Molecular Neurobiology (Professor/in - Hochschulen)
jobs.description:
Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz (JGU) is one of the largest universities in Germany. Thanks to its location in the Rhine-Main science region – home to the RMU Alliance formed by JGU, Goethe University, and TU Darmstadt – JGU can utilize its full potential and showcase its dynamic, innovative power. Its status as a comprehensive university allows for multidisciplinary learning and teaching at JGU, in turn, paving the way for internationally renowned, interdisciplinary research. Almost all of its faculties and departments are located on a single campus close to the Mainz city center, creating a lively academic culture for researchers, teaching staff, and students from all over the world.

The Institute of Developmental Biology and Neurobiology at the Faculty of Biology invites applications for the position of a

University Professor of Functional Genomics and Molecular Neurobiology

beginning at the earliest date possible. Salary grade W 2 LBesG | Civil servant (tenured)

Tasks and expectations:

We seek an outstanding candidate with a strong expertise in genetics and molecular biology, including the application of these approaches to the nervous system. Internationally recognised expertise and a strong track record of successfully securing external funding are required. Collaboration within the Faculty of Biology, the University Medical Centre, the Institute of Molecular Biology (IMB) and participation in current and future research consortia is expected.

The successful candidate will receive departmental positions and start-up funds and will be expected to establish an independent and internationally visible research program sustained by third party funding. Examples of further cooperation opportunities include: Institute of Quantitative and Computational Biosciences (IQCB) as well as collaborative research centres (e.g. CRC 1361 DNA Repair & Genome Stability; CRC 1551 Polymer Concepts in Cellular Function), the Research Unit FOR 5289 (From Imprecision to Robustness in Neural Circuit Assembly), or the Research Training Groups 4R (R-Loop Regulation in Robustness and Resilience) and GenEvo (Gene regulation in Evolution), the Carl-Zeiss-funded project for Interactive Bio-materials for Neural Regeneration and profile areas such as ReALity (Resilience - Adaptation - Longevity) or the Centre of Healthy Aging (further details here). The Rhine-Main Neuroscience Network (rmn²) offers further collaboration opportunities within the Rhine Main region.

Finally, the successful candidate will teach practical and theoretical courses in genetics, molecular biology and neurobiology at the Bachelor’s and Master’s level. We seek to increase the number of courses taught in English. Teaching is conducted in English and, in the basic Bachelor modules, in German. Applicants are therefore expected to be proficient in English and German. German language skills need to be acquired within five years of appointment. Participation in academic service is expected.

Requirements:

- In addition to the general requirements according to public services law, applicants must meet the recruitment requirements stipulated in Section 49 of the Hochschulgesetz of Rhineland-Palatinate. 
- In addition to the doctorate, a demonstration of excellent academic achievements is required. 

The state of Rhineland-Palatinate and JGU are committed to close personal mentoring of students and expect teaching staff to have a strong presence on campus. A cooperative, team-oriented and proactive work attitude, strong communication skills, and the willingness to assume responsibility – including further professional development in accordance with JGU’s leadership guidelines – is also expected.

Commitments of JGU:

JGU firmly supports making family and career compatible and promotes its employees’ further professional development. JGU welcomes qualified applications from people from diverse backgrounds. JGU aims to increase the number of women in research and teaching and therefore encourages female researchers to apply.

Candidates with severe disabilities or with equivalent status (as defined by section 2 subsection 3 of the Ninth Book of the Social Code, SGB IX) and appropriate qualifications will be given priority.

Please upload your complete application information and documents (CV, references, diplomas and certificates, as well as lists of publications and teaching activities, funding record, current research and future research plans, teaching concept) no later than September 30, 2026 via our portal with the following link: (https://berufungsportal.uni-mainz.de/datenabfrage/Genomics_Neurobiology)

https://berufungsportal.uni-mainz.de/datenabfrage/Genomics_Neurobiology (https://berufungsportal.uni-mainz.de/datenabfrage/Genomics_Neurobiology)

The interview symposium is tentatively planned for November 2026.

For questions and further information, please contact the chairperson of the search committee Prof. Martin Heine (marthein@uni-mainz.de).

Information on data protection: https://karriere.uni-mainz.de/en/#hinweise-zum-datenschutz (https://karriere.uni-mainz.de/en/#hinweise-zum-datenschutz)

jobs.occupation: Professorship in One Health, Animal Hygiene and Animal Disease Control (W3) (Professor/in - Hochschulen)
jobs.description:
The Faculty of Veterinary Medicine seeks to fill the mentioned above professorship at the earliest opportunity:

Academic context
Founded in 1409, the University of Leipzig is one of Germany's largest, most research-intensive and leading medical universities. It offers a dynamic and international working environment as well as attractive and diverse career opportunities in research, teaching, transfer, infrastructure and administration. The Faculty of Veterinary Medicine serves as a centre for interdisciplinary research in the fields of animal health, veterinary public health, public health and One Health.

The Institute of Animal Hygiene and Public Veterinary Services is a member of the Centre for Veterinary Public Health at the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine. It has modern BSL-2 (Biosafety Level 2) laboratory facilities, an interdisciplinary research environment and a wide-ranging international network.

Future Duties
The professorship is responsible for independently representing the field of animal hygiene and animal disease control in teaching [in accordance with § 32 "Animal husbandry and animal hygiene" and § 39 "Animal disease control and infectious disease epidemiology" of the Ordinance on the Licensing of Veterinarians (Verordnung zur Approbation von Tierärztinnen und Tierärzten – TAppV)], research and services. In the subject of animal disease control, teaching is carried out in cooperation with the Centre for Infectious Diseases (Zentrum für Infektionsmedizin – ZIM). The professorship is also responsible for managing the Institute of Animal Hygiene and Veterinary Public Health.

The professorship is expected to strengthen the faculty's research profile, especially the One Health approach, and to focus on the rapid detection and containment of infectious diseases in animals, animal epidemics and zoonoses (Pandemic Preparedness). Compatibility and collaboration in the research priorities of the faculty (www.vetmed.uni-leipzig.de/forschung/forschungsschwerpunkte) and university (www.uni-leipzig.de/en/research/research-profile/strategic-orientation-of-our-research; www.uni-leipzig.de/en/newsdetail/artikel/strategic-research-profiling-leipzig-university-designates-eleven-emerging-fields-along-the-leipzig-way-2025-12-17) and the development of interdisciplinary and international clusters are expressly desired.

A teaching and research concept demonstrating the relevance of the planned projects to the research priorities of the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine and other university institutions should be submitted with the application.

Requirements
In addition to in-depth knowledge of classical animal hygiene combined with modern, technology-based strategies for disease control, outstanding research and publication achievements, particularly in the fields of animal hygiene and/or infection epidemiology, experience in teaching and the successful acquisition of competitive third-party funding, especially international joint research projects are expected. Extensive experience in teaching and postgraduate continuing education and training, experience in personnel management and development are required. Proof of a veterinary licence and approval as a veterinary specialist for animal hygiene or in a relevant field, as well as proof of a postdoctoral qualification or equivalent achievements, must be provided.

The job holder’s rights and obligations are regulated by the Saxon Higher Education Act (SächsHSG) and the Saxon Service Regulations for Higher Education Institutions (HSDAVO). Applicants must meet the requirements of § 59 SächsHSG.

Research, teaching, transfer, infrastructure and administration require a diversity of perspectives. The university is therefore committed to diversity and equal opportunities. We welcome your application, regardless of gender, nationality, religion, cultural and social background, age or sexual orientation. The university aims to increase the proportion of women in academia and therefore expressly encourages qualified women to apply.

Severely disabled persons – or persons deemed legally equal to them under Book IX of the German Social Code – are encouraged to apply and will be given preference in the case of equal suitability. If you have any questions about accessibility or need assistance with this application process, please contact Leipzig University’s disability officers at: schwerbehindertenvertretung@uni-leipzig.de.

Please apply in English by 17 September 2026 exclusively via Leipzig University’s recruitment portal (http://www.uni-leipzig.de/berufungen)

Leipzig University
Dean of the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine 
Prof. Dr. Dr. Thomas Vahlenkamp

Join us, grow with us, and together, let's shape the future of biological discovery. 

‎

About the opportunity

Join QIAGEN as an Information Security Manager and play a key role in strengthening our global information security and compliance landscape. In this role, you will own and continuously enhance our Information Security Management System (ISMS), ensuring alignment with ISO 27001 requirements and evolving regulatory expectations. Working closely with internal stakeholders and external partners, you will drive security governance, risk management, compliance initiatives, and security awareness activities across the organization. This position offers the opportunity to shape strategic security programs while supporting a dynamic, international, and highly regulated business environment.

This position can be based in Germany (Hilden) or Poland (Wroclaw). Occasional international travel may be required.

Your tasks include
* Own, maintain, and continuously improve QIAGEN’s Information Security Management System (ISMS) and Security Compliance Program, including the ongoing development of our ISO 27001 certification framework
* Develop, maintain, and communicate information security policies, standards, and procedures across the organization
* Support internal and external audits, certification activities, and regulatory compliance programs
* Conduct information security risk assessments, compliance reviews, gap analyses and track remediation
* Advise business stakeholders on information security, cybersecurity, governance, risk, and compliance
* Contribute to the company-wide security awareness program and monitor emerging cyber threats, industry trends, and regulatory developments

Your profile

* Minimum of 3 years of experience in information security, cybersecurity, governance, risk and compliance, or a comparable role within an international organization
* Proven track record in implementing, managing, and improving an ISO 27001-certified Information Security Management System (ISMS), ideally within a manufacturing or regulated environment
* Professional certification such as ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, CISSP, CISM, or equivalent
* Strong knowledge of ISO 27001 requirements, information security governance, risk management methodologies, and relevant European and German cybersecurity regulations
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with fluency in German and English
* Strategic, analytical, and solution-oriented mindset, combined with a pragmatic approach and the ability to influence stakeholders across a multinational organization

What we offer

* Local benefits   

* Referral Program  

* Volunteer Day

jobs.occupation: Robotics Manufacturing Engineer, Line Design, Geartrain (Automobil-Fachwirt/in)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

In this role you’ll support the design, construction, launch, and transfer of geartrain manufacturing lines and equipment used in Optimus Actuators. This role will prioritize successful design and launch of production line while maintaining maximum efficiency, production volume, and safety while validating performance and fully documenting all aspects of the project for handover to sustaining operations.  The ideal candidate will bring deep technical expertise in high-volume geartrain manufacturing lines and the successful introduction of new technologies to mass production line. They must demonstrate experience translating manufacturing requirements into efficient, detailed production line designs that are robust and practical to implement . In this position, you will take ownership of production line creation of specialized equipment from concept through line launch completion—defining performance requirements, running process flow simulations as needed to validate solutions grounded in first principles, and leading commissioning through final validation.

What You’ll Do

- Use CAD software and simulation tools (e.g., AutoCAD, FactoryCAD, or similar) to create 2D/3D models, floor plans, and detailed drawings that support both main production line and also supporting areas within Geartrain Manufacturing Scope
- Work with factory simulation/modeling teams to develop flow manufacturing constraints for new equipment development such as aisle sizing, incoming raw materials to the cell and work in progress areas between cells
- Install, commission, integrate and troubleshoot new equipment and tooling and support setup for manufacturing, including machines, peripheral equipment, tools, and automation systems
- Oversee the handover of commissioned lines to production teams, including operator training, documentation of procedures and manufacturing BOM, and resolution of issues during line launch
- Contribute to R&D efforts in equipment design and process development by integrating layout considerations, material flow, and facility requirements early in the innovation cycle to enable scalable and efficient manufacturing solutions
- Design and develop detailed cell and production line layouts for each gearbox, including placement of machinery and their integration to the mainline, workstations, material flow paths, utilities, and storage areas to optimize production processes and efficiency
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Factory, Infrastructure, Material Flow, Design, Manufacturing Eng., EHS personnel, and project&program leads) to integrate layouts into main factory design
- Ensure compliance with Tesla safety regulations, ergonomic standards, and lean manufacturing principles while evaluating new equipment and processes from R&D initiatives
- Evaluate data on production performance, material handling, and space utilization to recommend layout improvements that align with ongoing R&D advancements in equipment and manufacturing processes
- Design custom fixtures, tooling, and other structures that would be used in manufacturing cells as needed, providing detailed build to print models/drawings for fabrication

What You’ll Bring

- Degree in Industrial Engineering or a related field (advanced degree or relevant certifications are a plus), or equivalent industry experience and evidence of exceptional ability
- Several years of experience in manufacturing or industrial engineering, with hands-on involvement in factory/plant layout projects
- Proficiency in layout design software, process simulation tools, and data analysis
- Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, material flow, ergonomics, and facility safety standards
- Experience designing layouts, mechanical equipment, fixturing, and tooling
- Knowledge in high speed gantry design including the pick and place into conveyor systems
- Knowledge in material flow analysis and basic knowledge about different industrial robots in high speed material transfer and pick and place applications
- Experience with SolidWorks CAD and PDM software. Familiarity with other CAD software (i.e CATIA, Siemens NX) also applies
- Experience with automation equipment, CNC equipment, heat treatment, assembly and end of line testing equipment
- Strong understanding of drafting standards and the application of GD&T (e.g., ASME Y14.5)
- Ability to communicate at a professional level in English language, both verbally and written
- Ability to travel internationally on a regular basis

jobs.occupation: Robotics CAE Engineer, Optimus (Automobil-Fachwirt/in)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

The Tesla Robotics Team designs and builds humanoid bi-pedal robots (Optimus) to perform tasks that are boring, repetitive, and dangerous for humans. As a CAE Engineer, you will guide the design of sensors and structural components using high-fidelity FE models grounded in sound engineering principles Working closely with mechanical, electrical, controls, software, and manufacturing teams, you’ll analyze and optimize designs, challenge traditional CAE methods, and pioneer more efficient, accurate approaches. This role places you at the forefront of critical design and engineering decisions, shaping a robust and reliable humanoid robot that has never been executed before.

What You’ll Do

- Develop and analyze comprehensive Finite Element (FE) models for Optimus, from individual components to the full system
- Conduct static, dynamic, structural and MBD simulations to evaluate and validate the performance against key requirements for strength, stiffness, durability and sensing
- Build and refine simulation workflows to assess performance across diverse operating scenarios, automate processes, documentation, and tools to improve efficiency, accuracy, and repeatability
- Provide design guidance to world-class engineering teams, enabling data-driven product decisions
- Collaborate with Test Engineering to design and validate experiments, correlate test data with simulations, and enhance predictive modeling capabilities
- Establish and maintain modeling standards, methods, and best practices for current and future programs
- Material characterization and advanced modeling of structural and sensing components
- Plan and execute large-scale DOEs, creating ML driven surrogate models to extract insights to drive key design decisions

What You’ll Bring

- Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience
- Strong foundation in Engineering Mechanics, Computational Mechanics, Material Science, and Finite Element Theory and applications
- Demonstrated ability to guide structural, sensing, thermal, and mechanism designs through CAE, from concept to mass production, across robotics, automotive, and consumer electronics
- Expertise in building high-fidelity FE models at component, sub-system, and full-system levels
- Proficiency in linear and non-linear static, dynamic and modal simulations and experience developing multi-physics simulation workflows (e.g., thermal-mechanical, mechanical-electrical)
- Advanced knowledge in material characterization and modeling, including nonlinear elasticity, viscoelasticity, creep, and strain-rate dependent plasticity in Metals, Plastics, Polymers and Adhesives
- Proficiency in CAE Tools such as BETA CAE, LS-DYNA, Abaqus, ADAMS, COMSOL, OPTISTRUCT, Design Life, FE Safe
- Strong programming and data analysis skills in MATLAB, Python, or equivalent
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams
- Ability to communicate at a professional level in English language, both verbally and written
- Ability to travel internationally on a regular basis

Optimus actuator team is seeking a skilled and highly motivated, engineer with gearbox manufacturing, design, assembly, machining and metrology experience to join the team. We work with the cross-functional teams (Design, Quality, Production, Sustaining, and Supply Chain) throughout the entire lifecycle of a product (from initial design through prototype development and into full production) to develop volume manufacturable designs and processes that will produce gearboxes. The role of the Gearbox Manufacturing Engineer is to support gearbox manufacturing process development to produce world-class gearbox prototypes and drive scalable production methods to high volume production. The ideal candidate takes pride in their work, has excellent engineering and physics fundamentals, is excited about manufacturing process development, does not shy away from a challenge, highly organized, has good great attention to detail, and is able to work in fast paced development environment with analytical and practical engineering focus.

What You’ll Do

- Develop scalable manufacturing technologies that can scale from concept to high-volume production for gearboxes
- Drive demonstration of developed gearbox manufacturing processes in a low volume, high-mix environment
- Establish equipment requirements for high volume gearbox manufacturing and develop high-volume manufacturing methods Drive machine tool equipment and tooling design developments with external suppliers and with internal entities for scalable high-volume (automotive level) production
- Develop specifications and manage RFQ process for new manufacturing equipment
- Design and build tooling that will be used gearbox assembly processes
- Work closely with design engineering team to provide crucial input on DFM and DFA
- Track and document process development activities on geartrain assembly, machining and heat treatment processes and report results when necessary
- Develop equipment manufacturing, heat treatment, inspection, and test validation plans
- Coordinate factory equipment installation, commissioning, and production hand off

- Mindset to apply first principles for problem solving
